re-run convergence cases for both faces

summary: Install's schema modeline is content-keyed: a re-run re-points a modeline whose $schema is not the desired one instead of keeping it on presence

per.section: The placements and their enforcement modes

acceptance: A version bump re-run of install converges every managed modeline to the current schema ref; an already-current modeline is Unchanged and byte-identical
tests: unrepresented install re-run re-points a stale-version CDN modeline at the current version
represented install re-run re-points a modeline whose schema ref differs from the lock's
pins: install re-run leaves a current modeline unchanged
notes: From build note UNREPRESENTED-INSTALL-PLACES-THE-CDN-MODELINE: presence-keying leaves an old @<version> URL standing. 'Every managed line is content-keyed' entails convergence; only the modeline line's bytes are rewritten (round-trip discipline).
